# `lot` commands

## `lot list`

The lots (batches) on file by item, earliest expiry first, with where each is; in_stock, site and expiring_by narrow it (lots expiring by a date).

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/lot.list` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow lot list --expiring-by 2027-06-30 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "lot list", "input": {"expiring_by": "2027-06-30"}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | `--item` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only this item's numbers. |
| `site` | `--site` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only numbers held at this site. |
| `in_stock` | `--in-stock` | boolean | no | no | false | Only numbers with a quantity on hand. |
| `expiring_by` | `--expiring-by` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Lots only: those expiring on or before this date. |
| `as_of` | `--as-of` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer | no | no | 200 | minimum 1; maximum 1000 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/lot.list`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `numbers` | array[object] | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].kind` | literal["lot", "serial_number"] | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].item_id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].item_name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].number` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].version` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].expiry_date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `numbers[].expired` | boolean | no | no | false | — |
| `numbers[].memo` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `numbers[].as_of` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].on_hand` | string | yes | no | — | Quantity on hand across sites (a serial number: 1, 0, or -1 when sold before its receipt). |
| `numbers[].places` | array[object] | no | no | [] | Where it is: each site holding it. |
| `numbers[].places[].site_id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].places[].site_name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].places[].bin_id` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `numbers[].places[].lot` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `numbers[].places[].serial_number` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `numbers[].places[].quantity` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `numbers[].last_document` | string \| null | no | yes | null | The document that last moved it, in words. |
| `numbers[].status` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `count` | integer | yes | no | — | — |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "count": 0,
  "numbers": []
}
```

## `lot show`

Where a lot is now: quantity on hand by site, expiry, and the document that last moved it. Example: `bookflow lot show L-2207 --item Sealant`.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/lot.show` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow lot show S-2611 --item "Pipe Sealant" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "lot show", "input": {"number": "S-2611", "item": "Pipe Sealant"}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | `--item` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Item the number belongs to; needed only when two items share the number. |
| `number` | `NUMBER` | string | yes | no | — | The lot or serial number, or its ID.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |

## `lot update`

Change a lot's expiry date (or clear it) or its memo; quantities move only with stock documents.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/lot.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow lot update S-2611 --expiry-date 2027-04-30 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Supplier corrected the expiry" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "lot update", "input": {"number": "S-2611", "expiry_date": "2027-04-30"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | `--item` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Item the lot belongs to; needed only when two items share the number. |
| `number` | `NUMBER` | string | yes | no | — | The lot number or its ID.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `expiry_date` | `--expiry-date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New expiry date; give null with clear_expiry to remove it. |
| `clear_expiry` | `--clear-expiry` | boolean | no | no | false | — |
| `memo` | `--memo` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
